pair.title: Connect your charger
pair.intro: Enter the IP address of your charger. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the charger.
pair.hint: Tip: give the charger a fixed IP address in your router. The charger accepts only one Modbus connection, so disable other Modbus apps or devices that talk to it.
pair.no_answer: Charger is reachable but does not answer Modbus requests. Is another app or device connected to it over Modbus (for example an old Modbus app or a test version of this app)? Turn that off, wait a minute and try again.
pair.unreachable: Charger not found at this address (__error__). Check the IP address and that the charger is on the network.

phase.not_supported: Phase switching is not supported by this charger (needs a 3-phase charger with firmware 3.187.0 or newer).
